title: The Invisible Cost Eating Your Savings Every Year
recommendedTitle: The Invisible Cost Eating Your Savings Every Year
alternativeTitles: Why ₹100,000 in Cash Loses Purchasing Power in 10 Years
The Hidden Tax on Cash: What Inflation Actually Does to Your Money
description:
If you leave money sitting idle in a savings account, its numerical balance never drops. But its real-world purchasing power quietly shrinks with every passing year.

We explore the mechanics of inflation, demonstrating why cash in a vault guarantees a loss in purchasing power and why productive assets are essential to beat rising living costs.
